description: This file declares exported API functions for the Server List Management Object (SLMO), including creation, removal, and initialization functions. It serves as a header defining interfaces for server detection components.

methods.name: CfSlmoComponentCreate
methods.description: Creates a component instance of the Server List Management Object with provided container, owner, and reserved handles.

methods.name: CfSlmoCreate
methods.description: Creates an instance of the Server List Management Object with specified contexts.

methods.name: CfSlmoRemove
methods.description: Removes a specified Server List Management Object instance.

methods.name: CfSlmoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls the necessary objects for the Server List Management Object.

methods.name: CfSlmoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the Server List Management Object.
